reasoning: In March 2016, Google DeepMind's AlphaGo defeated 18-time world champion Go player Lee Sedol 4 games to 1 in Seoul, South Korea. Prior to the match, artificial intelligence researchers and Go experts widely believed that a computer program defeating a top-ranked human Go professional was at least a decade away, making AlphaGo's victory a landmark milestone accomplished significantly ahead of expectations.
